title: The Verdict
stamp: Not rationalising. Just arguing. Still lost.

scenes.text: Let’s be honest. I wasn’t rationalising, I was just arguing. And you can’t argue with a person who knows what “bronde” is.
Her hair isn’t grey, mine isn’t brownish, and both are, apparently, a shade I can’t pronounce.
So here’s the plan: say “you’re right”, buy flowers, and ask what colour they are. Don’t say red. It’s “dusty rose”.
